```{r}
## Regenerate the noise of replication b_show and refit with its selected lambdas
set.seed(1000 + b_show)
y_show <- as.vector(truth_vec_t2 + rnorm(length(truth_vec_t2), 0, sigma_sim_t2))

ops_show <- prepare_admm_operators(D_space_t2, D_time_t2, n = length(y_show), rho = 1)
fit_show <- admm_fusedlasso3d(y = y_show, ops = ops_show,
                              lambda1 = res$lambda1[b_show],
                              lambda2 = res$lambda2[b_show],
                              max_iter = 500, verbose = FALSE)
beta_show <- snap_beta_to_clusters(fit_show$beta, fit_show$z1, fit_show$z2,
                                   edge_pairs_space_t2, edge_pairs_time_t2,
                                   n = length(y_show))

cat(sprintf("b = %d | MSE(obs) = %.4f, MSE(beta) = %.4f (from res: %.4f, %.4f)\n",
            b_show, mean((y_show - truth_vec_t2)^2), mean((beta_show - truth_vec_t2)^2),
            res$mse_obs[b_show], res$mse_beta[b_show]))

## Build observed and estimated stacks
```

### MSE

Boxplots of the MSE of the temporal differences over the B replications: Q1 -\> Q2 (true change only in cluster A) and Q2 -\> Q3 (true changes in clusters A and C), observed data vs fused lasso estimate.

```{r}
mse_long_t2 <- data.frame(
  mse = c(res$mse_obs_d12, res$mse_beta_d12, res$mse_obs_d23, res$mse_beta_d23),
  transition = rep(c("Q1 -> Q2", "Q2 -> Q3"), each = 2 * B_t2),
  source = rep(rep(c("Observed", "Estimated"), each = B_t2), times = 2)
)
mse_long_t2$source <- factor(mse_long_t2$source, levels = c("Observed", "Estimated"))

ggplot(mse_long_t2, aes(x = transition, y = mse, fill = source)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis", begin = 0.3, end = 0.9) +
  labs(title = paste0("MSE of temporal differences over B=", B_t2, " replications"),
       x = NULL, y = "MSE", fill = NULL) +

        axis.text = element_text(size = 13),       
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14))
```

MSE by cluster and quarter. The three clusters follow different trajectories, so the shrinkage bias can differ across them (the sudden decline of cluster C is the hardest case for the fused lasso).

### Accuracy

Change detection summary. The true changes are 4 pixels in Q1 -\> Q2 (growth cluster) and 8 in Q2 -\> Q3 (4 growth + 4 decline), so `tp_d12` should be 4, `tp_d23` should be 8, and the false positives and false negatives should be 0 when the clusters are recovered exactly.

```{r}
summary(res[, c("acc_d12", "tp_d12", "fp_d12", "fn_d12", "tp_growth_d12",
                "acc_d23", "tp_d23", "fp_d23", "fn_d23", "tp_growth_d23", "tp_decline_d23")])
```

Replications with false positives and the lambdas selected by BIC across the B replications.

```{r}
res[res$fp_d12 > 0 | res$fp_d23 > 0,
    c("b", "lambda1", "lambda2", "fp_d12", "fp_d23", "ari", "mse_beta")]

table(lambda1 = round(res$lambda1, 4), lambda2 = round(res$lambda2, 4))
```

### Cluster means

Mean estimate of each cluster in each quarter against the true value, over the B replications. This replaces the center-block analysis of Test 1: it quantifies how much of each trajectory (growth, stable, sudden decline) is recovered, and the bias is the shrinkage induced by the penalties.

```{r}
true_means <- sapply(mask_list, function(m) colMeans(Tr_t2[m, , drop = FALSE]))   # quarters x clusters

est_cols <- grep("^est_(growth|stable|decline|bg)_q", names(res), value = TRUE)

bias_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(est_cols, function(cn) {
  parts <- strsplit(sub("^est_", "", cn), "_")[[1]]
  cl <- parts[1]
  q  <- as.integer(sub("q", "", parts[2]))
  data.frame(cluster  = cl,
             quarter  = q,
             truth    = true_means[q, cl],
             est_mean = mean(res[[cn]]),
             est_sd   = sd(res[[cn]]),
             bias     = mean(res[[cn]]) - true_means[q, cl],
             row.names = NULL)
}))
bias_tab
```

Estimated jumps for the two clusters with a true change, compared with the true values (growth: +1 in each transition; decline: -2 at Q3).

```{r}
summary(res$est_growth_q2  - res$est_growth_q1)    # true value = 1
summary(res$est_growth_q3  - res$est_growth_q2)    # true value = 1
summary(res$est_decline_q3 - res$est_decline_q2)   # true value = -2
```
